notes: Read all 105 source lines (numbered) before editing. The hook resolves the static command-palette registry against live React context (navigate, theme, toast, queryClient, selected-vehicle, i18n) and returns commands / getById / filter. Seven inputs are browser- or web-app-coupled; each is ported behind a native-safe facade per the established conventions (useKeyboardShortcuts injected onNavigate + globalThis window CustomEvent facade; VehiclePicker/globalShortcuts useTranslation fallback shim; _toastHelpers Alert.alert toast; globalShortcuts/errorClassification inlining of the not-yet-ported commandRegistry).
L1 `import { useCallback, useMemo } from 'react'` -> `import {useCallback, useMemo} from 'react'` (RN-compatible; hooks/-dir prettier drops inner-brace spacing; both used).

L2 `import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'` REMOVED — react-router-dom is browser-only and not a native dependency. Its single use (L46 `const navigate = useNavigate()`) is replaced by an optional `onNavigate(path)` callback on the hook's options (the useKeyboardShortcuts/Breadcrumbs injected-navigation precedent); inert `noop` when omitted. reactRouterNavigateAvailable:false recorded in nativeCommandRegistryCapabilities. The CommandContext.navigate type narrows `NavigateFunction` to `(path: string) => void` (the registry only ever calls navigate('/path')).

L3 `import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'` PRESERVED — @tanstack/react-query is a real native dependency (apps/native/package.json). Used by the ctx `invalidateAll` exactly as on web.

L4 `import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next'` REMOVED — react-i18next is unavailable in native parity. Its use (L51 `const { t } = useTranslation()`) is replaced by an optional injected `t` plus a local `defaultTranslate` shim (the VehiclePicker/globalShortcuts precedent) supporting both call shapes the registry uses — `t(key, fallback)` and `t(key, {defaultValue, ...vars})` — and resolving `{{var}}` interpolation. translationProviderAvailable:false. CommandTranslate + CommandTranslateOptions exported so a caller can pass a real t.

L5 `import { useTheme } from '@/components/ui/ThemeProvider'` REMOVED — ThemeProvider not ported. Its use (L48 `const { setMode, setTheme } = useTheme()`) is replaced by optional `setMode`/`setTheme` callbacks; inert noops when omitted. themeProviderAvailable:false. The `ModeId` ('dark'|'light'|'oled'|'midnight'|'auto'|'sunset'|'nord') and `ThemeId` ('neon-cyan'|'tesla-red'|'matrix-green'|'royal-purple'|'solar-amber'|'custom') types are inlined verbatim from ThemeProvider so setMode/setTheme stay strongly typed (the registry uses dark/light/oled/midnight/auto + all five named themes).

L6 `import { useToast } from '@/components/feedback/Toast'` REMOVED — Toast not ported. Its use (L49 `const toast = useToast()`) is replaced by an optional injected `toast` plus a `defaultToast` that routes success/error/info through React Native `Alert.alert` (the api/hooks `_toastHelpers` precedent). toastQueueAvailable:false. CommandToast interface exported.

L7 `import { useSelectedVehicleStore } from '@/store/selectedVehicle'` REMOVED — the Zustand selected-vehicle store is not ported. Its use (L50 `const { setVehicleId } = useSelectedVehicleStore()`) is replaced by an optional `setVehicleId(id: number | null)` callback; inert noop when omitted. selectedVehicleStoreAvailable:false. (No default command in the registry calls setVehicleId — dynamic vehicle-switch commands are generated elsewhere on web — but the CommandContext field is preserved for parity.)

L8-14 `import { commandRegistry, scoreCommand, type CommandContext, type CommandDefinition, type CommandSection } from '@/lib/commandRegistry'` REMOVED as an import and INLINED. web/src/lib/commandRegistry.ts is not yet present in the native web-parity tree (it pulls Lucide DOM icon components, react-router NavigateFunction types, window.dispatchEvent CustomEvent perform() handlers, document.documentElement.classList, and @/lib/commandFrecency), so following the globalShortcuts/errorClassification inlining precedent the full `commandRegistry` array (all 30 default commands), `scoreCommand`, and the `CommandSection`/`CommandContext`/`CommandDefinition` types are ported into this module as a faithful projection. Every id, labelKey, labelFallback, section, keywords[], and shortcut is preserved byte-for-byte. The Lucide icon component (`Icons.moon`, …) is projected to a stable icon-name string via the exported `CommandIcon` union (moon/sun/sunMoon/palette/refresh/notifications/notificationsActive/workflow/locked/speed/history/terminal/download/settings/keyboard/bug/helpCircle/edit/layoutDashboard/add/undo) so a native CommandPalette can map name->glyph; CommandDefinition.icon and ResolvedCommand.icon are typed `CommandIcon` (ResolvedCommand keeps `CommandDefinition['icon']`).

Inlined registry perform() side effects ported to native-safe facades: the 6 `window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(name))` handlers (pref.themePicker 'open-theme-popover', time-machine.open 'time-machine.open-picker', action.shortcuts 'toggle-keyboard-shortcuts', feedback.open 'open-feedback-modal', action.tour TOUR_OPEN_LAUNCHER_EVENT='teslasync:tour:openLauncher', action.changelog.openModal 'teslasync:changelog:open') route through `dispatchAppEvent(name)` (a real `globalThis.window` + `CustomEvent` on the react-native-web target preserves the exact event names; pure native no-ops, windowEventBusAvailable:false). The 4 dashboard handlers' `ctx.navigate('/dashboard'); window.setTimeout(()=>window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('dashboard:*')),50)` -> `ctx.navigate('/dashboard'); scheduleAppEvent('dashboard:*',50)` (global setTimeout + dispatchAppEvent), preserving the navigate-then-dispatch-on-next-tick order and the 50ms delay. pref.theme.toggleMode's `document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark')` -> `isDarkMode()` document facade (real dark-class read on react-native-web; defaults to dark off-DOM). action.frecency.reset's `_resetFrecency()` -> `resetFrecencyStorage()` removing the same `teslasync:cmd-frecency:v1` key via the globalThis localStorage facade in a silent try/catch (frecencyStorageAvailable:false). feedback.open's id kept literally 'feedback.open' per the web audit-gate note. `scoreCommand` ported verbatim incl. the `/[\s\-_/:.]+/` acronym split (pure JS, identical under Hermes).

L16-30 `export interface ResolvedCommand` ported field-for-field with JSDoc (id, label, section: CommandSection | string, icon: CommandDefinition['icon'], keywords: string[], shortcut?, source: 'registry' | 'extension', invoke: () => void | Promise<void>) — the public contract the (not-yet-ported) native CommandPalette will consume; preserved exactly.

L32-44 useCommandRegistry JSDoc (resolves the static registry against live handles; returns commands/getById(id)/filter(query); cheap to call) carried over and adapted: notes that useQueryClient() is the only live provider dependency on native and the rest arrive via options or native-safe defaults.

L45 `export function useCommandRegistry()` -> `export function useCommandRegistry(options: UseCommandRegistryOptions = {}): UseCommandRegistryResult` — options is fully optional so the web zero-argument call site still compiles; UseCommandRegistryOptions (onNavigate/setMode/setTheme/setVehicleId/toast/t, all optional) + UseCommandRegistryResult exported.

L46-51 live-handle resolution ported: L46 `const navigate = useNavigate()` -> `const {onNavigate = noop, ...} = options`; L47 `const queryClient = useQueryClient()` preserved verbatim; L48 `const { setMode, setTheme } = useTheme()` -> destructured options defaults (noop); L49 `const toast = useToast()` -> `toast = defaultToast`; L50 `const { setVehicleId } = useSelectedVehicleStore()` -> `setVehicleId = noop`; L51 `const { t } = useTranslation()` -> `t = defaultTranslate`. Default handles are stable module-level refs so the ctx useMemo does not churn.

L53-70 `const ctx = useMemo<CommandContext>(() => ({navigate, setMode, setTheme, setVehicleId, invalidateAll: async () => { await queryClient.invalidateQueries() }, t, toast: {success/error/info wrappers}}), [navigate, setMode, setTheme, setVehicleId, queryClient, toast, t])` ported 1:1: `navigate` field assigned `onNavigate`; `invalidateAll` keeps `await queryClient.invalidateQueries()` verbatim; the toast success/error/info wrapper functions and the full dependency array (navigate->onNavigate) preserved; web `(msg: string) =>` kept as-is (already no outer-paren-free since typed). exhaustive-deps satisfied.

[], shortcut, source: 'registry' as const, invoke: () => def.perform(ctx)})), [ctx, t])` ported 1:1. L92-102 `const filter = useCallback((query) => { if (!query.trim()) return commands; const scored = commands.map(c => ({c, score: scoreCommand(query, c.label, c.keywords)})).filter(s => s.score > 0).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score); return scored.map(s => s.c) }, [commands])` ported 1:1 with the empty-query short-circuit, the score map/filter/sort pipeline, and the `[commands]` deps preserved; arrow params de-parenthesised per native prettier; `{c, score}` brace-spacing dropped.

The exported surface ResolvedCommand + useCommandRegistry matches the web source file 1:1; the inlined commandRegistry/scoreCommand/CommandSection/CommandContext/CommandDefinition (web @/lib/commandRegistry's own exports) plus CommandIcon/CommandToast/CommandTranslate/CommandTranslateOptions/ModeId/ThemeId/UseCommandRegistryOptions/UseCommandRegistryResult/nativeCommandRegistryCapabilities are additive native-safe exports.
